now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#16
now.text: Mysterio joins the Sinister Six that the Master Planner re-forms at Christmas.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A member of Otto's new Sinister Six.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Mysterio's leader in the Sinister Six.

proposed.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#17
proposed.text: Otto is unmasked as the Master Planner, the hidden boss Mysterio stole tech for and fought under in the new Sinister Six.

changes.evidence: In #16 (Reinforcement) the Six are gathered by an unseen Master Planner, and Otto appears only as the reformed Ravencroft patient who refuses to join; the Master Planner is revealed as Otto in #17 (Shear Strength), where Otto praises the Tinkerer and the Vulture for assembling 'the technology Mysterio stole'. A #16 boss stage between Otto and Mysterio, with the card line 'Mysterio's leader in the Sinister Six', gives away the #17 reveal. The connection's sibling Master Planner ties (Otto with Kraven, the Tinkerer and Electro) all start at #17.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#17
now.text: Kraven joins the Sinister Six that the Master Planner re-forms at Christmas.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A member of Otto's new Sinister Six.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Kraven's leader in the Sinister Six.

proposed.text: Otto is unmasked as the Master Planner, the boss who brought Kraven into the new Sinister Six and sent him to break Electro out of Ravencroft.

changes.evidence: Kraven joining the re-formed Six and the Christmas Eve attack happen in #16 (Reinforcement), not #17. In #17 (Shear Strength) the Master Planner is revealed as Otto, and Electro asks why Otto stayed behind when Kraven broke them out of Ravencroft on Christmas Eve. The stage stays at #17 because a #16 boss stage would spoil the reveal.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#17
now.text: He returns in both Sinister Six teams and serves as Doctor Octopus's right hand.

proposed.text: As the Master Planner's right hand, the Vulture snatches Gwen off the street and flies away with her before Peter can follow.

changes.evidence: The text sums up several episodes (both Sinister Six teams, #11 and #16) instead of #17. In #17 (Shear Strength) the Vulture works at Otto's side in the lair, then carries the knocked-out Gwen away while Peter watches and loses sight of them, and goes on to attack Homeland Security.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#17
now.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's best friend and true love.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Gwen's best friend and true love, now dating Liz.

proposed.text: Spider-Man rescues Gwen from the Master Planner's lair. At midnight, while Gwen is on the phone with Peter, Liz kisses him.

changes.evidence: 'Peter starts dating Liz' is about Peter and a third person. In #17 (Shear Strength) Spider-Man saves the kidnapped Gwen from Otto's flooding lair; at New Year's Peter calls Gwen, and Liz kisses him at midnight while Gwen calls out on the phone.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#18
now.text: Back from Europe, Harry asks Gwen to be his date to Flash's birthday party.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's best friend, back from Europe.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Harry's best friend, who also loves Gwen.

proposed.text: Peter sees Harry come back to school from Europe, knowing his friend was once the Green Goblin.

changes.evidence: The text is about Harry and Gwen, not Peter and Harry. In #18 (First Steps) 'Peter also witnesses Harry's return from Europe, following the revelation of his identity as the Green Goblin'. Harry asking Gwen to Flash's party is already the Harry and Gwen #18 stage.

owner_calls.question: The #19 stage text 'Gwen starts dating Harry' tells what Gwen does with Harry, not something between Peter and Gwen. Keep it as love-triangle context, or rewrite it to a Peter and Gwen moment from #19?
options: Rewrite once a #19 Peter and Gwen scene is sourced
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database #19 (Growing Pains) synopsis says only 'Harry and Gwen start dating'; no source found gives a Peter and Gwen scene in #19.

owner_calls.question: The #19 stage text 'Harry and Gwen start dating' tells what Harry does with Gwen, not something between Peter and Harry. Keep it as love-triangle context, or rewrite it (Harry is jealous of Peter, whom Norman still seems to favor, but sources do not pin that to #19)?
options: Rewrite to Harry's jealousy of Peter if it is confirmed in #19
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database #19 synopsis: 'Harry and Gwen start dating. Harry's father is on the phone with him and says that he is proud of him.' The Marvel Animated Harry page says 'around the same time' Harry shows jealousy of Peter, without naming the episode.
